download_k700_dataset: download the K700 dataset video paths, annotations, and video archives to a root directory
create_k700_split: create a disk_folder format split with extracted middle frames and .npy filelist files for train or val
extract_middle_frame: extract the middle frame from a video file following the CLIP protocol for image-based video representation
clean_k700_label: clean a K700 class label by removing parentheses and replacing spaces with underscores
run_k700_data_pipeline: run the full K700 data creation pipeline with argparse to download and convert videos to image splits
